findings.desc: M9/M10 million-record baseline verifier scans corpus membership but does not execute runtime matcher/ranking path, so scale correctness can pass even if retrieval is broken.
findings.resolvedReason: Baseline verifier now executes real MemoryFreshnessPack runtime matching/ranking via shortlisted records, and full 1M smoke passed with expectedIdsFoundRate=1 and current-over-superseded preference=1.

findings.desc: 1M baseline test does not execute the runtime search/ranking/pack path against gold queries; broken retriever/ranker could still pass if IDs exist in corpus.
findings.resolvedReason: Runtime baseline no longer verifies only manifest/member presence. The verifier calls buildMemoryFreshnessPack against baseline-derived memory/playbook stores, and negative controls reject candidate and superseded false surfaces.

findings.desc: playbook_runtime_health consumer wiring checks use weak self-matching tokens for story/DONE consumers and would not catch removal of MemoryFreshnessPack wiring.
findings.resolvedReason: playbook_runtime_health now checks concrete MemoryFreshnessPack wiring patterns per consumer, and health smoke includes a fake source tree that has weak legacy tokens but no real wiring and must fail.

findings.desc: MVP2 smoke covers done_closure and final_response_check but not done_prepare, despite done_prepare memory rendering being changed.
findings.resolvedReason: MVP2 smoke now invokes createDonePrepareHandlers().done_prepare on a TEST story and asserts DONE prepare output includes Advisory memory considered, non-authoritative memory, gateEvidence false, and memoryCompletionProof false.

findings.desc: final_response_check is documented as advisory-only but is registered as critical, so enforce+baseline could mark it blocking.
findings.resolvedReason: final_response_check is now explicitly advisory-only in runtime consumer policy and MVP2 asserts it remains advisory even when policy is evaluated.

findings.desc: agy fallback documentation says programmatic primary-host status, while implementation accepts caller-provided primaryHostFailure string; boundary must be aligned or implemented.
findings.resolvedReason: Execution plan now matches implementation: agy fallback requires a concrete structured primary-host failure signal from host runtime, operator, or wrapper adapter; programmatic probing is documented as an adapter source rather than MVP requirement.

findings.desc: memory_playbook_baseline_generate is classified readOnly/destructiveRisk none even though it writes to caller-selected outputDir and force=true recursively removes that directory.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 33c1cf5db: memory_playbook_baseline_generate is no longer readOnly/destructiveRisk none. It is classified as dangerousMutating/workspace-destructive in command-policy, L2 memory-runtime-write in process-fact-levels, and command catalog text now states force may replace outputDir. Verified by npm build, playbook-runtime-memory-mvp2-smoke, command-catalog-smoke, and process/runtime fact contracts.

findings.desc: verifyPlaybookRuntimeBaseline parses gold-queries.json but does not compare it with manifest.goldDigest, so tampered easier gold queries can still produce status pass.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 33c1cf5db: verifyPlaybookRuntimeBaseline now computes recordsDigestStable and goldDigestStable, includes both in pass criteria, exposes them in JSON/text output, and baseline smoke includes a gold-queries tamper negative control. Verified by build plus small and full 1,000,000-record baseline smokes.

findings.desc: dev_memory_finish_decision interpolates storyId directly into a filename, allowing storyId values with path separators to write outside the finish-decisions directory.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 33c1cf5db: dev_memory_finish_decision now validates storyId with canonical Proofbound story-id rules before path derivation and uses only the safe path segment for finish-decisions storage. Health smoke rejects path traversal/storyId separator inputs and asserts no outside files are written.

findings.desc: Runtime host policy accepts labels such as codex-cli, claude-cli, and agy-cli, but handoff/dispatch still pass the original host string into registries that recognize codex, claude-code, and antigravity. toHost:"claude-cli" or agy-cli can look allowed while pack/status resolves unknown/fallback.

Baseline verification trusts manifest.recordCount and does not enforce PROFILE_COUNTS or fullProfileExactMillion. A truncated corpus with a self-consistent refreshed manifest can pass without containing the promised 1,000,000 full-profile rows.

Baseline generation only refuses outputDir when manifest.json exists. If outputDir already exists without a manifest, records.jsonl can be overwritten even when force is false, contradicting the command safety contract.
